name: Chiron Development
description: Defines Chironian expression across the universal developmental stages without changing the adaptive function.

content.coreRule: Development changes how adaptation operates; it does not change Chiron's identity.

functionalPattern: Responds to limitation automatically
Develops compensatory habits without clearly naming the original constraint
Avoids situations that expose uneven capacity
Identifies strongly with recurrence or difficulty
Overcompensates to prevent exposure
Withdraws before support can be negotiated
Builds identity around being the helper, expert, or survivor
Treats accommodation as proof of inadequacy
requiredConditions: explicit exposure, shame, or inadequacy evidence

functionalPattern: Tests accommodations and alternative methods
Builds skill through repetition and feedback
Learns to communicate limits
Begins sharing adaptive knowledge without universalizing it
learningTaskComponents: Distinguish personal experience from general law

functionalPattern: Modifies function realistically around a persistent constraint
Uses accommodations without shame
Develops practical competence through experience
Shares adaptive knowledge while preserving boundaries
learningTaskComponents: Prevent expertise from becoming rigid identity
Receive support as readily as it is offered

functionalPattern: Uses vulnerability and competence together without role collapse
Adapts flexibly without demanding cure
Transforms lived experience into context-sensitive guidance
Supports participation while respecting real limits
eligibleVerbs: receive support without loss of agency
requiredConditions: sustained coordination between limitation, agency, support, and participation
developmentalContribution: Makes participation possible without denying limitation
Turns personal adaptation into transferable but non-universal knowledge
Allows expertise and vulnerability to coexist
Builds systems that accommodate variation without reducing dignity

crossStageRules.rule: The same adaptive domain may use different verbs at different stages.
Healing language requires explicit evidence and may not replace adaptation.
Integrated Chiron may still require ongoing accommodation.
Healthy expression does not imply the limitation has disappeared.
No stage may introduce a semantic domain absent from Chiron's approved vocabulary.

provenance.sourcePolicy: Component-only Chiron vocabulary. Psychology and development qualify adaptive expression but do not redefine Chiron as a wound, diagnosis, or cure.
